title: VERDICT: Agreement Beats Pixel-Space Verification in Real-Document OCSR
abstract: arXiv:2608.22183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) converts 2D molecular depictions in the published literature into SMILES, and is increasingly important for constructing large-scale chemical training datasets. Automation at that scale requires identifying unreliable predictions in the absence of ground truth. Three families of label-free signals were compared on $263$ ACS journal depictions with verified ground truth: model confidence, re-rendering similarity, and agreement among recognizers. Pixel-space re-rendering performed little better than chance (AUROC $0.547$, $95\%$ CI $[0.465,0.629]$), and an oracle-tuned threshold on it reduced correct labels per image from $0.745$ to $0.205$. Agreement among four architecturally distinct recognizers instead reached an AUROC of $0.916$ ($[0.880,0.952]$). The two-of-four rule accepted $81.7\%$ of images at $88.8\%$ precision, the three-of-four rule $52.1\%$ at $98.5\%$. The same pattern held on

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22183v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：光学化学结构识别（OCSR）将已发表文献中的二维分子图像转换为SMILES表示，对于构建大规模化学训练数据集日益重要。在该规模下自动化需要在没有真实标签的情况下识别不可靠的预测。本研究在263个具有已验证真实标签的ACS期刊图像上比较了三类无标签信号：模型置信度、重新渲染相似度以及识别器间的一致性。像素空间重新渲染的表现仅略优于随机（AUROC 0.547，95%置信区间[0.465,0.629]），基于该信号的神谕调优阈值将每张图像的正确标签数从0.745降至0.205。而四种架构不同的识别器间一致性达到了AUROC 0.916（[0.880,0.952]）。二选四规则接受了81.7%的图像，精确率为88.8%；三选四规则接受了52.1%的图像，精确率为98.5%。同样的模式在...
tldr: 该论文发现，在真实文档的光学化学结构识别中，基于识别器间一致性的验证方法（AUROC 0.916）显著优于像素空间重新渲染方法（AUROC 0.547），表明无需真实标签时，多模型一致性是更可靠的错误检测信号。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that agreement-based verification among recognizers (AUROC 0.916) significantly outperforms pixel-space re-rendering (AUROC 0.547) for real-document OCSR, demonstrating multi-model consensus as a more reliable label-free error detection signal.
